checks.name: Full integration gate

checks.name: Real-service browser acceptance
checks.detail: Actual synthetic Python/Vite HTTP/WebSockets, 0→1→2→3→0 count cycle, caps1/3/6, both trackers, controls, epochs, bounded slow consumer, source end, service outage and release retry.

checks.name: Decode-delay regression
checks.detail: Actual synthetic JPEG delayed 2000ms in browser: baseline15a56dc accepts/draws; final corrected viewer discards at 1440/390/320 widths, shows consistent stale/active-source feedback. Final screenshots refreshed and inspected.

checks.name: Physical calibration and latency
checks.detail: No physical cameras were used or calibrated. Independent ground truth and physical latency measurements were unavailable; separate M1 gates remain open.

checks.name: XYZ serial benchmark
checks.detail: 22 scenarios × 3 methods, 180 frames × 3 people × 17 joints per scenario/method; 18,000 measured stage batches, three trials and 30 warmups per workload/trial. Midpoint selected: nominal root/wrist p95 1.93/2.54 cm at 100% coverage; three-person p95 4.842 ms. Three-person DLT 5.238 ms and refinement 15.941 ms miss the provisional 5 ms gate. Full failures retained.

checks.name: Report browser verification
checks.detail: English report rendered at 1440/390/320; all embedded images loaded, no external rendering requests/overflow/unexpected errors. Initial missing favicon404 was identified and corrected with inline data favicon, then rerun passed.

checks.name: Production build
checks.detail: pnpm build passed: source-only workspace phase, TypeScript, 101 Vite modules, all three application entries and emitted asset references verified. No new distributable package.

reviews.name: Independent correctness review
reviews.scope: Issue #3 software acceptance: 10/10. Issue #4 camera-free software acceptance: 10/10. Physical M1 certification excluded.
reviews.evidence: Sol reviewer inspected final source, benchmark data, full check/build logs, report metadata and desktop/mobile stale-state screenshots. All prior deductions resolved: receipt-age freshness/recovery, clear labels, owning docs, geometry-amplified timing regression, integrated checks, measured comparison and report. No outstanding scoped correctness findings; hosted CI remains a separate latest-head gate.

reviews.name: Independent acceptance and report review
reviews.scope: Declared camera-free software acceptance and report delivery. Physical camera/calibration/latency certification excluded.
reviews.evidence: A second Sol reviewer personally exercised the real Python/Vite streams, lifecycle/outage controls and before/after JPEG-delay regression; inspected freshness, XYZ provenance/rejection code and benchmark framing; reviewed the full 408 TypeScript / 196 Python test gate and three-entry production build. Report passed offline browser checks at desktop/mobile/narrow widths. No outstanding scoped findings; latest-head hosted CI remains required before merge.

regression: Baseline viewer: 3 new controlled-clock regressions failed and 39 existing cases passed. The correction covers expired first/replacement bitmaps, fresh recovery, residual decode budget, control redraw and stale/Stop labels. Real browser delay also reproduced accepted old imagery before the fix and zero expired-image draws after it.
browserSummary: English at 1440×1050, 390×844 and 320×740, no horizontal overflow. Actual synthetic service transports, no source or HTTP/WebSocket mocks. A 650ms slow-consumer pause skipped 12 superseded observations with zero unsolicited messages. Six independent synthetic epochs. Deliberate service outage has separately recorded expected network errors.

checks: Live synthetic entering/leaving sequence 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 0 through both real streams.
